source.objective: C2 throughput starvation: the Inbox drain gate blocks all non-P0 roadmap dispatch whenever any issue_inbox row is pending or triage is reconciling. Current supervisor snapshot has 181 pending Inbox rows; the triage fallback has recently reduced only about 7-8 rows per 40-46 minute run. At the same time, 65 pending work items have no work_item_execution_spec, including 53 executor_policy=auto items, so runnable_with_spec is effectively zero. Many of these were promoted from the Inbox. This creates a self-sustaining loop where Inbox growth halts the roadmap while promotions become pending-but-undispatchable. Replace the global drain barrier with a reserved triage lane/slot; do not mark promoted auto work pending until an executable spec or explicit planning state exists; and use cheaper deterministic/batched triage with model escalation only for ambiguous rows.
